description: 102-source research universe ordered by authority class. Authority score is a source prior, not a forecast or verified historical accuracy score. Registration does not imply permission for every use; data/calendar adapters are documented separately from RSS news ingestion.

scoring_policy.authority_score: Prior source-authority weight on 0-100 scale. Primary official releases/data receive highest weight; media and specialist research lower; broker research is discounted.
scoring_policy.source_independence: Multiple outlets repeating the same wire story count as one underlying information event, not independent confirmations.
scoring_policy.direction: Only assign currency impact when the affected country/currency and directional transmission channel are explicit; otherwise mark neutral_or_unclear.
scoring_policy.conflict: Store bullish and bearish evidence separately; do not average contradictory views into false consensus.
scoring_policy.freshness: Use publication timestamp and collection timestamp; stale material decays and cannot outrank fresh official releases.
scoring_policy.trade_entry: Final pair ranking requires fresh market data, a directional technical setup, event-risk filter, spread/volatility checks and defined invalidation. No source-authority score alone creates an entry.
